summary: Tested the new Claude AI Model selector feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Created /app/backend/tests/test_ai_model_selection.py (10 pytest cases, all passing): ai_prefs.model GET/PUT round-trip for all 4 catalog keys (gpt-5.4, claude-sonnet-5, claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5), schema accepts unknown/legacy keys (resolve_model fallback), and CRITICAL end-to-end suggestion generation through emergentintegrations/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY for each of the 4 models. Confirmed via a supplementary manual script that Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Claude Sonnet 5 all returned real, contextually-correct suggestion payloads (e.g. 'You haven't logged any water today...', reason citing water_ml_today/overdue_count) — not just empty/null responses. Backend logs show LiteLLM completion() calls resolving correctly to claude-sonnet-5 / claude-sonnet-4-6 / claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 model ids with zero exceptions/tracebacks (the 'provider = openai' in logs is expected — Emergent's universal key routes all providers through one openai-compatible proxy endpoint, this is not a bug). Frontend: logged in as testuser@lifeos.app, navigated More -> AI group -> AI Model screen — all 4 rows render correctly (label, provider badge, description, GPT-5.4 pre-selected by default). Tapped Claude Sonnet 4.6: checkmark moved immediately (optimistic UI), persisted after navigating back to More hub and re-entering the screen (proves PUT/GET /api/me/preferences round-trip works live). Switched back to GPT-5.4 successfully (regression on original provider path). Light regression pass: login, Today dashboard (rendered a live water suggestion for testuser in production), More hub navigation to Privacy Center/Notifications/Backup & storage all working, and the 'Smart suggestions' ai_enabled toggle (PATCH /api/me/profile) correctly flips off/on and persists visually.

issues: 'Smart suggestions' card subtitle still says 'ChatGPT-powered nudges on Today' — now stale/misleading copy since users can pick Claude models via the new AI Model screen. Minor cosmetic text fix, not a functional bug.

action_items: Update More hub 'Smart suggestions' subtitle copy to be provider-agnostic (e.g. 'AI-powered nudges on Today') since it no longer exclusively uses GPT.
critical_code_review_comments: core/ai_models.py: clean single-source-of-truth catalog with safe resolve_model() fallback — good defensive design, confirmed working when tested with an unknown model key.
suggestion_engine.py correctly reads Preference.ai_prefs.model per-call (not cached), so provider switches take effect immediately on the next suggestion generation — verified in this session.

routes/ai.py _maybe_generate_suggestion only generates when no pending suggestion exists for the day; tests had to explicitly dismiss pending suggestions between model switches to force fresh generations — this is correct/expected product behavior, not a bug, but worth knowing for future test authors.
